changes.text: Optionally turn each new voice note into a task in Things or Apple Reminders; existing notes and later edits are not exported.
Choose Off, Things, or Apple Reminders in Notes Settings, with Things Inbox/Today and Reminders list and No date/Today controls.
Keep delivery progress for iPhone and Watch notes, with background Watch notes waiting until Teika is open and idle.
Document optional note-text transfers to Things and Apple Reminders, their sync services, permissions, and local delivery tracking.
Explain task integrations, delivery recovery, and destination choices on the website and in support documentation.
Recover failed deliveries with Retry or Skip, and require confirmation before retrying an unconfirmed task to avoid duplicates.
Avoid repeating a complete task title in its description while preserving extra lines, truncated titles, and a marked excerpt for transcripts beyond Things' limit.
Add regression coverage and a macOS validation command for Things/Reminders exports, note persistence, and migration.

Track changes and release assignments, author grouped customer-facing notes separately from the full ledger, preserve resumable release evidence, automate App Store metadata and review submission, capture screenshots, and publish website updates through the existing Git deployment.
Locate the system back control by its identifier so Settings navigation validation also works when iOS places it in a separate toolbar.
Fall back to a compatible simulator model and runtime when the newest runtime rejects an App Store screenshot device.
Export fully opaque simulator PNGs as RGB for App Store screenshots, verifying identical pixels and dimensions and rejecting real transparency.
Lead with Apple Reminders in release notes, store and website descriptions, and the first integration screenshot on iPhone and iPad.
